# Third-party notices

The site bundles these open-source libraries so 3D feature tiles can render without a runtime CDN request.

- **`@google/model-viewer` 4.4.0** — Google model-viewer web component, distributed under Apache License 2.0. The distributed minified file includes a BSD-3-Clause license banner; see `MODEL-VIEWER-LICENSE.txt` and the file header.
- **Three.js Draco decoder files** — `draco_decoder.js`, `draco_wasm_wrapper.js` and `draco_decoder.wasm` are from Three.js 0.183.0's `examples/jsm/libs/draco/gltf/` folder and Google's Draco decoder (Apache License 2.0). The bundled Three.js notice is in `THREE-LICENSE.txt`.

Sources: <https://www.npmjs.com/package/@google/model-viewer>, <https://www.npmjs.com/package/three>, <https://github.com/google/draco>.
